batting.dismissal: c R Powell b Sandeep Sharma

batting.dismissal: c R Parag b Sandeep Sharma

batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b Sandeep Sharma

balls.text: 125.3kmh, slower ball outside off that Bumrah swings across for and gets two off the inner edge to leg

five wickets for Sandeep Sharma! David swings big, he has to because it's a full toss, even if low. He dispatches it high into the sky and that comes down at the cow corner where Riyan Parag makes it look very easy
128.8kmh, pulls the short ball from way outside off to deep midwicket and denies the single
a full toss outside off and Chawla gently pushes it down to long-off
two in two for Sandeep! 124.4kmh and shaping away from well outside off, Coetzee smashes it down the ground but he's not middled that and Hetmyer runs in to grab that without losing his balance
finds long-on where Powell pouches it with a tumble. An excellent innings with a salvaging act and some attacking strokes comes to an end. He tries to whack that away but can't clear long-on

excellent over because of an excellent save from Hetmyer. He slides to his right from long-off after David lofts that straight down the ground, and Hetmyer throws it to long-on so the throw can go back quickly
nails the yorker outside off, Tilak digs it out towards cover point for one
138.4kmh, another one in the block hole as David walks across and he only gets a single to long-on with a swing down the ground
goes wide again outside off, he has the field for it, but that's also a wide
excellent ball in the block hole outside off and David can't get it past cover
tries the wide yorker again, this time called a wide

trapped right in front and given straightaway! Hardik has reviewed this too. He missed a full toss with pace angling into the stumps, it struck him on the front pad right in front on the knee roll and ball-tracking says it's hitting. Hardik gone and Royals trying to limit Mumbai now after some carnage in the middle overs
136.6kmh, offers pace with a wide yorker and Hardik swings and misses. Mumbai review it for wide though. It went past the wide line but Hardik had moved towards the off side so not a wide
almost a yorker on middle and leg, and Haridk bunts it down to long-on
94.6kmh, driven into the covers for one with the spin and he gets one, but they get an overthrow too

too full, too straight and that's gone for four! Hardik took out a big back lift and struck that with power straight back, all along the ground and even though Hetmyer got to the ball with a dive from long-on, he pretty much slid over the ball
95.9kmh, quick and flat outside off, Hardik slices it bur can't clear point
wide and full outside off, he lofts it down to long-off after a bounce
pithed up and Hardik is happy to give strike to Tilak with a single to long-off
Tilak has spoiled Boult's over! Boult lands one on length and Wadhera has hammered that high and deep into the leg side with some power
111.2kmh, a slow bouncer to end the over but it's not the end because it's called wide by the square leg umpire
121kmh, short ball around hip high and Hardik pulls that behind square for one
right at the base of the stumps at 134.7kmh and Hardik can only block it back
in the block hole on off and Wadhera drills it back past the umpire and wants two but there's no time
cramps him up for room with the angle from outside off, Hardik steers it to off
strikes first ball and breaks the partnership! Slow bouncer wide of Wadhera, he has to go for the shot but can only hand a catch to short third. Didn't middle the upper cut at all
he attempts a third but Chahal has bowled that very wide, trying to bowl outside the arc, and Wadhera nearly holes out to deep cover running in, but lands just before Jaiswal
make that two in two! Full again, this time he goes full with a big swing and clears long-on for another clean six
Wadhera launches him into the orbit now! Too full around middle and leg and he's smacked that away into the crowd over midwicket
almost in the block hole around leg and he whips it away for one

Chahal has trapped him lbw the very next ball! On-field umpire gives out and Tilak reviews after consulting Wadhera. He went for the reverse sweep, missed and got hit on the front pad. Ball-tracking show that since it was hit on the full, it would go on straight with the angle and miss off stump
in the slot and Tilak has smoked that for six with a slog sweep! Gets to his fifty and 1000 IPL runs with his fifth fifty. Super stroke
Sandeep continues to bowl wide, and Tilak gets a single to deep point
spectacular stuff! Tilak has gone for a switch hit and he has middled that from wide outside off, well over short third for four!
slow, short and wide at 116.7kmh, Wadhera has to chase it a long way and miscues it high to cover but nobody there
another short bouncer, this one not as wide and Wadhera pulls and misses
bangs in a short one, Wadhera hops on his toes and goes for the upper cut to dispatch that fine and beat short third for four!
short and wide, angling away a fair bit and Tilak chases it for a single to deep point
short ball to end the over at 135.2kmh, too short, not just short and Wadhera just pounces on that to unleash a clean and flat six with a mighty pull
just a bit of width outside off and Tilak punches that wide of cover for one
too full on off, mid-off is in the circle and Tilak does well to drill that low full toss straight enough and beat mid-off for four
outside off and sliced to deep point for one
it's a one-handed six! Length ball towards the stumps, Wadhera goes big down the ground even though one hand comes off the bat in the follow though but he's cleared Powell at long-on
short ball because mid-off is in the circle, Tilak charges down and slips it wide of mid-off for one. And that's the fifty partnership that's brought Mumbai back in the game
fuller on the pads, worked to leg with soft hands away from any fielder and they hare back for the second
connects with the cut because this one is wider and gets a single
tries to cut the flat delivery outside off but only manages an inside edge that doesn't go anywhere
Wadhera continues to go with hard hands, and smashes it to deep cover for one
slows it down a bit for a low full toss on the stumps, flicked to leg for one
room outside off and he slaps it away to deep cover for one
too much width and that's been punished too! Four more to end the over. Flat and wide, Chahal probably trying to keep hot outside the batters' arc but he's been hit again to the cover boundary
short and wide again, and he hammers it down to long-off with a whippy swing
full on off and now it's a single down to long-off for one
92.5kmh, flat and full down leg, Wadhera probably got some bat to the keeper down leg as he tried to paddle it away. Nope, that's two wides
comes down and drives that one with the turn to long-on for one
too short, too wide and Tilak has rocked back in the crease to smash that away to the extra cover boundary for four
98.8kmh, some width outside off and he has punched that straight to cover
97.5kmh, too short, Wadhera has pulled that away and nicely in the gap on the leg side for a one-bounce four
some width and it's punched inside-out for one to long-off
fuller length and Wadhera sweeps it over square leg for one
makes room early and Ashwin adjusts the line to cramp him for room, Tilak still manages to drive it on off for one
more on middle and leg and Tilak whips it away to deep midwicket and that's excellent running to return for a second
98.7kmh, not too many revs because it's flat on middle and he scythes it square for one
131.1kmh, good ball to end the over, no room at all to punch it away and Wadhera clips it down to mid-on
121.5kmh, tries to keep it away from him with a short ball that's slow outside off but it's called wide after it's left alone
132.7kmh, just enough width to slice that away outside off but can't clear Jaiswal at point
133.9kmh, no room at all as he angles it into the stumps. Tilak defends to off
Tilak goes unconventional now! Goes down on a knee and scoops that short of length ball from outside off to the fine leg boundary
marginally wider outside off and Wadhera runs it down to deep third for one
superb delivery to make a comeback! Jags that into him with an upright seam position and splits Wadhera into half by beating his outside edge
95.4kmh, fuller on the pads and he works it down to long-on for one
flat on the pads again, another single to wide long-on
94.5kmh, quick and hurries into Wadhera, he gets some bat on the leg side for a single
opens up completely this time for the flat delivery at 97.7kmh, and pulls for one more
down the ground and he has smashed it into the sight screen! Confident footwork to come down and take it on the full and hit it absolutely straight
101.6kmh, quick outside off, Tilak pushes it to cover
leans forward for the length legbreak and blocks it back
smart placement from Wadhera. He goes across a long way and paddles that on the leg side because there's nobody in the deep. Four runs
flat on the stumps and he defends it back

wicket number 200 in IPL for Chahal! He's slowed it down to 85.1kmh on the stumps, Nabi is early into the shot and lobs an easy catch to the bowler on the off side. Chahal grabs it with both hands and is immediately down on his knees with his fingers pointing towards the sky. He's surrounded by his team-mates in no time and getting mobbed there with hugs and what not
flat at 94.3kmh on the stumps, Tilak goes back and whips it away to leg
hint of width outside off with legspin, Nabi drives with the turn for one
86kmh, much slower to end the over, fullish on off and Nabi gets a single down to long-off
flat and angling into the batter, he works it to deep midwicket for one
much fuller on off and Tilak drives to cover
flat and past the pads down leg for a wide
length ball turning into middle, Nabi goes back and clips it to deep midwicket for one
generously flighted this time with some dip and Tilak comes down to make it a low full toss and flick to leg for one
angling into the stumps and he defends it back
pretty tight outside off to end the over, Tilak defends with soft hands to point and calls for a single immediately
on the stumps this time and Nabi works it away with the angle to deep midwicket
four more! Nabi is turning it on for Mumbai. Avesh goes wide of the crease and continues to offer width, Nabi is aware there's no deep third and he slices that away in that gap
some width this time from Avesh and Nabi drives that away from his body and away from the fielders in the covers for four!
short ball, hooked for six! Short around off, Nabi swivels and goes after the short ball to get the first six of the game behind square
Nabi steers the short of length ball to point for one and the throw from there concedes an overthrow. Samson is not happy
131.7kmh, on the pads to end the over and Nabi doesn't connect for the swipe but gets a leg bye
139.1kmh, jags this one back into Tilak who works it down to mid-on for another quick single
some width outside off and Nabi pushes it away to deep cover for one
shorter ball and hence not with as much swing outside off, he steers to point for a quick single
back on target on off with some shape and Tilak defends into the covers
errs down the leg side with some speed. This was at 137.1kmh and called wide
lovely shape into the middle stump from around off, an inside edge gets Nabi a single to leg
122.9kmh, swinging in around off and Nabi flicks it past midwicket down to long-on for one. Not a maiden
more towards the stumps, no room really and he clips it along the ground to midwicket
no swing for the good length ball outside off, Nabi punches it back
touch fuller and he sends it back to mid-off again with a straight bat
lovely swing into Nabi, he covers his stumps and pushes to mid-off

SKY is gone as well, another big wicket for Sandeep! Scrambled seam from Sandeep on middle from good length, SKY wants to whip it away into the leg side but in the air and he has hit it high, for Powell to settle under it easily at mid-on
shorter ball to end the over and SKY heaves it across to deep square leg for one
right on off stump, not much swing, and SKY punches it back off the middle. Boult gets a hand to that or it could have got SKY some runs
just a hint of width, the ball is shaping in as well, but SKY has scythed that so well and so late into the gap, he deserves four for that! Excellent timing and placement
touch fuller and into the batter this time, he works it square
drives on the up away from the body, slightly uppishly, but he has struck that so well in the gap on the off side that he gets four
outside off now with some shape, short of length, and he steers it square for one
a bouncer from Boult first up! It's been called a wide for height. I don't think Tilak was expecting the short ball, he was surprised by it and slightly late on the shot
on the pads and Tilak tucks it away to fine leg for one more
nice swing into the batter towards the stumps, SKY waits and pushes it down to mid-on
swinging away from off stump, Tilak chases away from the body and gets a single past point. There's a fielder there in the deep

nearly edges it behind. Oh, Samson thinks there's an edge and he has reviewed it straightaway! Poking outside off and away from the body, UltraEdge shows a spike and the crowd loves it. Kishan is gone caught behind for a duck
plants his front foot towards the ball outside off and whacks it back to the bowler. Didn't middle it though
some width and angle outside off, but on good length and Kishan shoulders arms
swings the last ball into SKY and he works it down to mid-on

gone in the first over! Rohit opens up and goes for a big, big swing. He has skied that so high, it's not an easy catch for Samson even though he doesn't have to move too much. Settles under it nicely and Boult has got him again, struck in the first over
short of length and towards the stumps again, Rohit hangs back and tucks it square
pulls the length shorter towards the thighs and he defends it back, good bounce

Rohit gets four for that but he was squared up a little by the swing into the middle stump. Straightening from off towards middle, Rohit opens the face of the bat, well outside the crease, and gets a very thick edge along the ground past wide slip
swinging in, as expected, but a bit too much on the pads and he's flicked it away to deep square leg for two
Jaiswal hits the winning runs, goes back against a shortish ball and cuts it late past backward point. Once again has his arms aloft as he gets to the other end
Flatter and on a length on middle and leg, knocks it down to long-on. Doing it in singles are RR
Flatter on off, punched through wide mid-off for a couple
Flatter and on a length outside off, Jaiswal slaps it through cover and gets to the other end.  Hundred for Jaiswal - takes his helmet off, has his arms aloft and gives Samson a bear hug
Slower one outside off, hit straight to long-off. On 99 and on strike
Fuller outside off, eased down to long-on to bring up the century partnership
Fuller outside off, driven to short cover
Full outside off, drilled to long-off
Slower one outside off, punched to long-off
Length ball on leg, clipped to deep square leg
Outside off on a length, Samson lifts his bat to let it be
Slower and full outside off, driven through cover. Should have been a couple but Nabi fails to stop that in the deep
Full toss on middle, hits it to mid-off and runs with the shot
On a length just outside off, steered to short third
Smartly done. Yorker on the pads, 141.4kph, Samson flicks and gets it wide of short fine leg
Very full but sliding down leg, Samson jams his bat down but misses. Wide not called and Samson reviews. "If he hadn't moved, it would have hit his feet," rules the TV umpire
Fetch that! Back of a length around off, he arches back and cross-bats it way over deep midwicket. He moves into the 90s
Short again, he is a tad early into the pull and takes a blow on his left shoulder. Hardik winces in pain!
On a length outside off, punched to cover
Banged short, he ducks and then thinks of playing the ramp. Wide called
Outside off, punched through point for a couple

Kishan thinks there's an edge, Coetzee thinks there's an edge. But the on-field umpire signals a wide. Mumbai have reviewed. Back of a length angling down leg, Jaiswal goes for the heave by getting inside the line. No glove involved but it brushes the arm guard. Kishan had flown to his right to take that. Wide has been reversed
Length ball outside off, pushed towards point
Fuller on middle, flicked to long-on
Length ball around off, punches it wristily to long-on
Full and outside off, drilled to deep cover
Fuller just outside off, drilled straight to cover
Four more! Back of a length angled in to him from around the wicket, he gets inside the line and pulls it through fine leg
Airmiles galore! Slower one on a length around leg, Jaiswal heaves it 86m over deep square leg fence
Bouncer just outside leg, Jaiswal goes for the pull but is beaten. MI review it but lose it
Full length ball outside off, nudged through midwicket. And Bumrah has overstepped
Fuller on the stumps, punched straight to long-on
Flatter and outside off, punched to long-off
Excellent sweep. Gets across towards off, then see the ball around leg and sweeps it away from deep square leg, who dives and keeps it to two
Dancing shoes back on. Sees the flight, it is the googly again. Slinks down quickly and goes inside out to hit it way over wide long-off
Fuller on middle, knocked down to long-off
Very full on leg, nails the sweep through square leg using his reach to bring up the fifty partnership.
Length on middle, driven down to long-on

David drops one now. That was a very easy catch. Long-on comes in a few steps and fails to hang on. Hardik's back of a length slower one had done the trick. Almost. Samson went for the pull but never made good contact
On a length outside off, the off-pace one at 122.3kph, he backs away and makes no contact
Samson sends it sailing. Takes a step to leg just as Hardik reaches the crease. He bowls a slower one in the slot. A free swing sends it soaring over long-on
Sees Jaiswal backing away and follows him with a length ball. He looks to pull it away but gets an inside edge onto his body and to the on side
Outside off on a length, slapped to deep cover-point
Stays put in the crease and looks to steer it fine, but hits it towards short third
Flatter and on the stumps, he goes back and pushes it with soft hands towards mid-on and gets to the other end
Entices the big shot with the flighted ball outside off, he goes for the biggie but gets an inside edge onto the pads
Tossed up on the stumps, he pushes at it in front of the body
Shortish, slow outside off, goes back and heaves it to deep midwicket
Flatter and on the stumps, it is the googly, he goes back and turns it through midwicket
Shortish outside off, slapped to deep cover

Flying Tilak not enough to rein Samson in. Length ball from Nabi in line of the stumps, it was not too short for Samson to go back and heave it. He does so and beats deep midwicket, who flew to his right
Darts it on the pads, nurdled to short fine leg
Mindblowing shot. Brings back memories of Jaiswal's treatment to Bashir in the Tests against England. Uses his reach to get forward and slog sweep it well over deep midwicket
Quicker on the stumps, goes back and knocks it down to long-off
Flatter and on a length outside off, punched back

Dropped and six! It was not a bad effort, because Wadhera was backtracking a touch. But he couldn't hang on and spills it over. Jaiswal once again dances down and sliced it high, but ended up getting the desired result. Don't look at Chawla, Nehal!
Slower through the air, outside off, chopped towards point
Flatter and on a length just outside off, punched to long-off
Fuller on middle, comes forward and flicks it through midwicket to bring his first fifty of the season

Superb use of the crease from Jaiswal. Sees the flatter googly outside off, transfers his weight back and cuts it through point. Nabi hares to his right in the deep, dives but fails to pull it in despite multiple attempts
Flatter and fuller on middle and leg, wristed back towards the bowler
Fuller around off, lunges and defends it towards point for one
Excellent use of the feet. Tossed up on a length, Jaiswal slinks down and gets under it, tonks it straight and long
Flatter on off, punched to cover
Lands on a length outside off, goes back to punch it through sweeper
Fuller around off, pushes it through covers
Arm ball on a fullish length on leg, misses the defence on the inside

Timbaaaa! Chawla makes his frustration evident. Strikes right after the boundary. Slips in the wrong'un on a shortish length around off, Buttler goes back to punch but it turns in just a touch to clatter off
Gets it right this time, Buttler. Chawla slows it down, 90.6kph, and bowls it on middle and off. He once again switches stands and reverses it past backward point. Sweeper had no chance
Fuller on off, reverse swept to short third
Peach. Tossed up and lands it around off, gets it to spin away past Buttler's bat-swing!
Flatter and on a length just outside off, punched to deep cover
Tossed up full on off, squeezed through wide mid-on
Fuller on off, driven to cover
Spins away just past the outside edge. Draws Jaiswal forward and just goes away
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through square leg
Fuller and wider outside off, slapped to sweeper cover
Cracked away! Doesn't seem like the drizzle has had any effect on the outfield. Full ball around off, Jaiswal goes inside out and drives it all along the carpet. Long-off cannot get across
Fuller outside off, eased down to long-off

Fuller on off, drills it wide of mid-off. Hardik gets to his right but lets it through despite the dive. The best opening stand for Royals this season and only the second time in IPL 2024 has Jaiswal survived the powerplay
Full toss, punished. Outside off at 138.8kph, Jaiswal drills it through covers
Very full on leg, he manages to push it through mid-on
Fifty up for Royals! Length ball outside off, easy pickings for Buttler who frees his arms and lofts it over mid-off
Slower ball outside off, 118.5kph, it is shortish and outside off, Buttler goes back and lofts it over cover
Length ball outside off, pushed to cover
Claaaassss! Gets his front stride out, comes forward, and nails the drive through cover. It was on a fullish length outside off, and he managed to find the gap
On a length outside off, punched towards cover
Length ball around off, defended towards the bowler
Length ball on off, 125.2kph, Buttler does not get a huge stride forward and presents a straight bat face. Sees mid-on fairly deep and rushes to the other end
Nails it! Sort and outside off, 143kph, Buttler stands tall and crunches it through midwicket
Lovely slower one to start. Or so it looked, because the speed gun says 130.1kph. Buttler is through with the drive but the ball cuts in from outside off and goes from the inside
All timing as Jaiswal punches it through cover. Shortish and outside off, 151.1kph, he stands tall and presents the full face of the bat to pierce the gap
Slower ball gone wrong, as it goes very wide outside off
Beaten for pace but Jaiswal benefits! Bouncer targeted at his helmet at 149.7kph, he is rushed for the pull and gets a top edge over the wicketkeeper
Length on off, he gets behind it and defends it back towards the bowler
Short and speared down leg, he shoulders arms. 140.7kph
Back of a length, angling in around off, 149.9kph, Jaiswal sways back to ramp it but misses
Cranked up, 147.8kph, back of a length outside off, beaten for pace. A swish and a miss

Welcomed with a six! Coetzee runs in from over the wicket and lands it on a length outside off, 140.1kph. But high pace has never quite bothered Jaiswal. He clears his front leg and tonks it straight back
Punches the length ball on the up to mid-on

Just short and away from short third. Full and outside off at 134.8kph, Buttler goes at it with all hands no feet, gets a thick outside edge. Bumrah gets to his right from short third and dives but it is out of his reach. Deep backward point gets around to keep it to one
Length ball on leg, clipped to deep square leg
Slower one on off, 118.8kph, full just outside off, Buttler goes hard at it and gets it off the inner half through midwicket
Inswinging yorker on middle, Jaiswal does well to dig it out with an open bat face to guide it wide of short third
Begins with a low full toss on middle and leg, clipped to deep square leg
Goes for the yorker but dishes out a full toss outside off, Jaiswal gets a thick outside edge towards slip
Swinging away from a fuller length, Buttler is uncertain with his foot work and pushes it towards cover. Nabi dives and parries it to his right and allows a run
Length ball swinging in from the outside off, pushed defensively towards cover
Jagging back in from a length, beats Butter on the inside. Only Bumrah appeals. Height a factor because it hits him high on the back leg
Slower one to start on middle, 123.4kph, very full on middle, he gets his bat in front of his pad and defends it back
Angles it away, Jaiswal glides it to deep third
Length ball outside off, steered to deep third. 11 off the opening over of the chase
Aerially between short cover and extra cover! Another awayswinger at 136kph, Buttler goes hard at it and wasn't in full control but gets the desired result

Butter gets going with a boundary. Length ball, fuller than good length, 136.2kph and swinging away. Buttler leans forward and lets the hand do the reaching. The bottom hand comes off and it goes over mid-off
Length ball on off, defended towards covers from the crease
Length ball on the pads, nudged to fine leg to get going
Starts off with a length ball, 133.7kph, angling across Jaiswal. He covers the stumps and shoulders arms
